+# ============================================================
+# GRASP_FORWARD_NUDGE_V1
+#
+# After External image alignment AND Wrist jaw-corridor latch,
+# advance a very small distance along the previously observed
+# External X approach direction before allowing CLOSE.
+#
+# Initial conservative test:
+#   trigger  : <= 12 px External image error
+#   distance : 1.0 mm
+#   speed    : 1.0 mm/s

+
+GRASP_FORWARD_NUDGE_TRIGGER_PX = 12.0
+GRASP_FORWARD_NUDGE_DISTANCE_MM = 5.0

+# GRASP_SEQUENTIAL_ALIGNMENT_V3_CONSTANTS

+# Ordered grasp:
+# EXT_ALIGN -> WRIST_ALIGN -> 5 mm FORWARD_COMP -> CLOSE
+GRASP_SEQ_EXT_ERROR_MAX_PX = 10.0
+GRASP_SEQ_EXT_HOLD_S = 0.20
+
+# External alignment is NOT permanent.
+# If it drifts far away again before forward compensation,
+# return to EXT_ALIGN and reacquire.
+GRASP_SEQ_EXT_REACQUIRE_PX = 16.0
+
+GRASP_SEQ_WRIST_DU_MAX_PX = 8.0
+GRASP_SEQ_WRIST_DISTANCE_MAX_PX = 22.0
+GRASP_SEQ_WRIST_HOLD_S = 0.20

+

+grasp_forward_nudge_done = False

+
+# GRASP_SEQUENTIAL_ALIGNMENT_V3_STATE
+grasp_seq_ext_since = None
+grasp_seq_ext_ready = False
+
+grasp_seq_wrist_since = None

+    wrist_current_ok = bool(

+        and
+        jaw_corridor_current

+        abs(

+            if (

+    wrist_jaw_latched = bool(

+        and

+    elif (

+        grasp_forward_nudge_started_at = now

+        print(
+            "[GRASP NUDGE] START "
+            f"dir={grasp_forward_nudge_direction:+.0f} "
+            f"distance={GRASP_FORWARD_NUDGE_DISTANCE_MM:.2f}mm "
+            f"speed={GRASP_FORWARD_NUDGE_SPEED_MM_S:.2f}mm/s "
+            f"ext_err={ext_error_px:.1f}px",
+            flush=True,
+        )

+    #
+    # IMPORTANT:

+    #     Z <- existing fusion

+    # Sequential control is allowed ONLY inside the final

+    #
+    # During the nudge:
